caption: The drawing is created on beige paper and features two main objects. On the left, there is a shaded, gray pencil sketch of a gourd-like vessel or jug, which has a rounded body, a short neck, and an irregularly shaped base. The surface of the vessel appears rough with textured shading, and a small protrusion or separate object is visible at its base. On the right, there is a colored depiction of a shallow, round basket viewed from above, with intricate geometric and spiral patterns rendered in yellow, brown, tan, and black. The outer rim of the basket has a repeating zigzag pattern, and the inner part contains a swirling motif. Text and notations in black pencil are written in the lower left, identifying the items as related to the Havasupai tribe, and providing measurements. The signature "Geo. B. Willey" and the date "Oct. 8th '35" are inscribed in the lower right. The drawing is on a sheet of sketchpad paper with a spiral binding at the top edge.
title: Basket
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
